_blurb: Resmi açıklama (herkese, sosyal medya dahil) + 2 hafta ek havalimanı ve çağrı merkezi personeli

decisions.target: All Kestrel Air passengers and followers

actions.action: Extra airport and call-center staff for 2 weeks

decisions.message: Kestrel Air: you may have seen a video of mechanics working on one of our engines. The FAA and the engine maker asked airlines to inspect a part on one engine type, as a precaution. No Kestrel aircraft has had a problem with this part. We are inspecting the aircraft that use it now, and a few flights may be delayed while we do. Safety comes first. Extra staff are at our airports and on our phone lines if you need help.
decisions.why:
A viral video without an answer from us is the real risk; the facts are reassuring and we should say them first.
Extra staff keep any inspection delays from turning into long waits.
It costs $0.15M and leaves the budget for the strike.
